scripts.setup-vendor: bash -c 'source ../../.env && mkdir -p vendor && ln -sfn "$MACROFORGE_TS_CRATE" vendor/macroforge_ts && ln -sfn "$MACROFORGE_TS_MACROS_CRATE" vendor/macroforge_ts_macros && ln -sfn "$MACROFORGE_TS_QUOTE_CRATE" vendor/macroforge_ts_quote && ln -sfn "$MACROFORGE_TS_SYN_CRATE" vendor/macroforge_ts_syn'
scripts.build:native: deno install --node-modules-dir && deno run -A npm:@napi-rs/cli/napi build --platform --release --package playground-macros
scripts._comment_build_wasm: `macroforge build` rather than cargo + wasm-bindgen directly: it adds the `$` re-exports for Call macros ($state, $derived, $effect) that the vanilla playground imports. A raw wasm-bindgen run emits only the bare `state`/`derived`/`effect` exports, and the resulting package fails to type-check. Runs this checkout's debug CLI (`pixi run build:cli`), never the `macroforge` on PATH.
scripts.prepare: deno task setup-vendor && deno task build
scripts.clean: rm -f *.node || true; rm -rf target pkg node_modules
scripts.cleanbuild: deno task clean && deno install --node-modules-dir && deno task build
